issues: 左上角是调试标题「FLIP GRID REFLOW」，6 张卡全是灰色骨架条，没有内容可读
卡片只做等比放大 1.28，横排和网格是同一张卡，重排没有语义
浅灰底 + 平面白卡，整屏空、没有强调色和层次
直线飞行 + 整层亮度脉冲收尾，运动没有预备与重量
changes: look 改为 sand：虚构字体厂 Fount 的样张库，6 张卡 = 6 个字族的巨大「Ag」（Didot / Futura / Rockwell / 窄体 / 等宽 / 斜体），赤陶色只给主推字族一张
重排有界面上的因：光标滑到右上角 Row/Grid 切换器按下，滑块同拍滑到 Grid，页头计数补出「· 38 styles」
卡片从竖版 262×380 形变成横版 520×300，卡内字形与名称位置一起插值、落定后再浮现样张句——网格视图读作"看到更多"
运动：4f 集体下沉预备 → 每卡错峰 2f、22f 不对称 in-out 飞行（上排上弧、下排下弧）+ 速度方向模糊 + 抬高阴影 → 弹簧落座一次回弹
飞行期浮出 12 栏版式参考线、落定退去；收尾 1.5% 极缓推近 hold ~59f
issuesEn: A debug title 'FLIP GRID REFLOW' sat in the corner and all six cards were grey skeleton bars with nothing to read
Cards only scaled uniformly by 1.28, so row and grid showed the same card and the reflow meant nothing
Flat grey background and plain white cards: an empty frame with no accent or depth
Straight-line flights and a whole-layer brightness pulse, with no anticipation or weight
changesEn: Sand look: a specimen library for the fictional foundry Fount; each card is a huge 'Ag' in a different family (Didot, Futura, Rockwell, condensed, mono, italic), terracotta only on the featured one
The reflow has a cause: a cursor presses the Row/Grid toggle, the thumb slides on the same beat and the header count gains '· 38 styles'
Cards morph from 262x380 portrait to 520x300 landscape with their inner layout interpolating, and a sample sentence fades in after landing, so grid view reads as 'see more'
Motion: a 4f collective dip, then 2f-staggered 22f asymmetric in-out flights on upper/lower arcs with directional blur and lifted shadows, settling on a spring with one visible bounce
A 12-column layout guide surfaces during flight and fades on landing; the end holds about 59f with a 1.5% slow push
